stories.summary: Hundreds of thousands of Canadians call for Pete Hoekstra to be declared ‘persona non grata’ A petition signed by nearly 290,000 Canadians calling on Mark Carney’s government to oust Pete Hoekstra as US ambassador to Canada was formally presented to the House of Commons on Thursday, a sign of the strained relations between the neighboring countries. Elizabeth May, a Canadian Green party member, originally opened the petition for signatures in July 2026 after a woman from Calgary sponsored it. The petition requests that the Canadian government declare Hoekstra “persona non grata” due to his “US” diplomatic interference in Canadian domestic affairs”. Continue reading...

stories.title: Graham Thorpe’s widow takes legal action against NHS trust after inquest
stories.summary: Former England Test cricketer was diagnosed with anxiety and depression before he took his own life in 2024 The wife of Graham Thorpe, the former England cricketer who took his own life, has started legal proceedings against an NHS trust after an inquest identified “failings” in his mental health care. Thorpe died aged 55 in August 2024 in Surrey. His wife, Amanda, has lodged a personal injury claim at the high court against Surrey and Borders Partnership NHS foundation trust which was involved in his care, the Telegraph reported.
